description: Synthetic card scans for the placeholder-pipeline E2E gate. Generated by apps/web/scripts/generate-placeholder-fixtures.py --corner. CORNERED cards laid in the scanner bed's top-left corner, which the NEO-320 quad stage declines (frame_edge) and the identity check declines, so every one escalates to the heavy BiRefNet service. Both lists are in UPLOAD ORDER — front/back alternation. Each front and back print the SAME full player name so the identity pool pairs them. `files` is the contract the seed page reads; `images` is the same order with the metadata a human (or a flow author picking assertions) needs.
